artworks.title: Two Women Bathing (Les deux baigneuses)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a natural scene featuring two human figures. The drawing depicts two nude figures in an environment that resembles a body of water, surrounded by lush foliage. The figures are rendered with a combination of soft and defined lines. The branches and leaves above them provide a sense of depth and texture, with scribbled marks creating a canopy effect. The overall tone of the drawing is serene and intimate, capturing the natural interaction between the figures and their surroundings.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with the Young Saint John the Baptist (The Madonna of the Long Thigh)
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 41.1 × 27.5 cm (16 3/16 × 10 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows four figures in a serene setting among classical ruins. A woman with a baby on her lap is seated on the right. On the left, an older man with a donkey sits on a raised surface. In the middle, a young boy reaches towards the baby. The background features partially ruined buildings with arched doorways and windows.

artworks.title: Abraham and Isaac
artworks.medium: etching and burin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.1 x 13.3 cm (6 5/16 x 5 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing close to each other. The person on the left is slightly bent over, gesturing with their right hand raised and the other hand on their chest. They have a beard, wear a turban, flowing garment extending to the ground, and a sword tucked into their belt. The person on the right stands attentively, holding an elongated object. They have short, slightly curly hair, wear an ornate garment, and are barefoot. The background features subtle etchings of foliage, creating a natural setting with bushes and plants sketched around the scene, and textured ground details.

artworks.title: Roslin Castle
artworks.medium: etching and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a crumbling stone fortress with tall walls and a square tower on the left. The horizon is high and hidden by the fortress. The sky is pale with light clouds. The brushstrokes are soft, using watercolor technique on the stone and sky. The color scheme is earthy with grays, light browns, beige, and greenery. Two figures are seen on a path leading into the fortress. Further along the path, the viewer is led deeper into the structure.

artworks.title: West Gate at Canterbury
artworks.medium: etching and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a street scene of an old town area. Buildings and a large castle are prominent in the scene. The style is detailed with fine brushstrokes, defining architectural features and foliage of a tree. The color palette includes browns, grays, soft terracottas for buildings, and subtle greens for trees. The sky is light blue. Figures are present, some close by and others further down the street. A waterway is depicted at the base of the castle.

artworks.title: Saint Philip
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright facing forward, holding a staff in one hand. They have a serious expression and curly hair. The person is wearing a robe and standing on a plain surface.

artworks.title: Studies of Sudarium and Saint Agnes
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with white chalk on laid paper prepared with red wash
artworks.description: The image depicts several figures on a brown background. In the foreground, there is a partial depiction of a woman facing to the right with her head turned slightly to her left. She has long, wavy hair and is wearing a robe. To the left of her is a drawing of a lamb. Above the woman is a detailed drawing of a bird with outstretched wings. To the left is a drawing of a man's face with a crown of thorns, enclosed within a frame. The composition is surrounded by a plain, brown paper background with corner cuts.

artworks.title: Mezzetin
artworks.medium: red and black chalk counterproof on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Beatrice Beck Fahnstock

artworks.title: The Coquette
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray and brown wash
artworks.description: The image shows three women and a child in an indoor setting. The central figure is slightly bent forward, holding onto the gown of the woman to her right, who is supporting her. Both women wear intricate gowns with fitted bodices and layered skirts. They have styled hair and wear elaborate headpieces or caps. Behind the central figure, another woman lounges on a sofa or bed with an opulent drape. Beside her, a child sits playing a drum. The background features wall patterns and draped curtains, suggesting a richly furnished interior. The artwork is in monochrome tones, giving it a delicate appearance.

artworks.title: Kindly Martine
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray and brown wash
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic scene with a large sculpture of a horse in the background. The drawing depicts a woman pouring liquid into a bowl or container held by a child, with a statue or sculpture of a horse draped in cloth in the background. Several other figures appear in various activities throughout the image, and the scene takes place in what seems to be an indoor setting, possibly an atelier or market. The area is bustling with activity; on the table to the right, there is an arrangement of items, and at the bottom, there are freshly plucked chickens and some game. The use of shading and line work gives depth and structure, allowing the viewer to perceive the movement and interactions within the space.

artworks.title: Italian Landscape with a Boating Party
artworks.medium: gouache
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a low horizon line, showcasing fields, hills, structures, and distant mountains under a lightly clouded sky. In the foreground, there is a peaceful body of water where animals are seen, and a boat with figures. A grove of trees on the right displays rich earthy tones. The color palette is muted and natural, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Danae Receiving the Golden Shower
artworks.medium: red, white, and black chalk with gouache
artworks.description: This drawing shows a person's full body from the back. They are lounging on a soft fabric bed, their head and body turned towards the upper-right corner, away from us. The person's right arm extended above their head towards the upper-right corner, and their right leg is extended while the left leg is bent at the knee. Their brown hair is styled in a braid ending in a bun at the back of their head. Their skin is pale and appears to softly glow or reflect white light. Soft textured fabric surrounds them, drawn with gentle highlights and folds. The background is a smooth, neutral beige tone.

artworks.title: Ascension Day Festival at Venice
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over traces of graphite, tip of the brush with black wash, heightened with a few touches of white gouache (laid on thick eighteenth-century paper)
artworks.description: The image shows a busy waterway filled with various boats, some with figures on board. The boats are adorned with flags. In the background, there is a cityscape with a church tower and buildings. The brushstrokes are detailed, and the color palette consists mainly of brown and blue tones. The scene depicts a historic setting, with distant structures and a slightly overcast sky.

artworks.title: The Cathedral at Trani
artworks.medium: pen and gray-black ink and watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a town square with a grand church featuring a tall bell tower. The church has a detailed façade with a rose window and arched windows. In the background, there are arched buildings and trees. The brushstrokes are detailed, and the color palette is subdued with beige, brown, gray, and hints of green. People are seen engaging in various activities in the square. In the distance, ship masts are visible over a low wall, indicating the presence of a harbor.

artworks.title: Gardens of an Italian Villa (Villa Medici?)
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a outdoor scene with soft, detailed brushstrokes and a tranquil ambiance. The composition includes trees with thin trunks and delicate canopies on the left, and in the background, small figures are engaged in various activities around ladders, a cart wheel, and pieces of timber. The color palette consists of muted sepia tones, creating an aged, monochromatic appearance.

artworks.title: Interior of a Farmhouse with Figures
artworks.medium: pen and brown and black ink with brown wash heightened with white over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic interior scene. The image depicts a room within an old structure. Inside, the space is filled with various household items and exposed wooden beams line the ceiling. An open hearth is on the left side and a cat is resting nearby. Wooden stairs are on the right. Barrels and containers are stacked against the walls. The composition features a subdued palette of browns and grays.

artworks.title: L'Allee de Grenadiers
artworks.medium: watercolor heightened with gouache
artworks.description: The image shows a view from an elevated perspective, looking down upon a scene that includes a large structure on the left, possibly a castle or a grand building, partially obscured by lush greenery. The horizon is not defined, as the scene is built upwards with the structure and trees, creating a vertical composition. The brushstrokes are delicate and light, typical of a watercolor technique. The color palette consists of muted, earthy tones, cool shades of blue and green. Closest to us is a figure pushing a wheelbarrow filled with flowers, while to the right, beyond the figure, a group of people is interacting with a small boat. Natural and architectural elements are integrated, with leafy trees forming a canopy over the setting, their leaves rendered with dappled brushwork.

artworks.title: The Bedroom (Le Coucher or Ma Chemise brule)
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic interior. The drawing depicts a scene inside a room with various elements. There are individuals engaged in different activities. On the left, there is a table partially visible, with a draped curtain or cloth nearby. In the center, two figures are bending over near a small piece of furniture or object. At the top center, there is a framed decorative image or mirror on the wall, flanked by a birdcage hanging from the ceiling. On the right, a partially open door reveals another figure standing in a threshold, with bookshelves visible in the background, and a small animal such as a dog near the doorway. This drawing captures a snapshot of everyday life with soft, flowing lines and a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: Terrace and Garden of an Italian Villa
artworks.medium: red chalk over traces of black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed depiction of a lush, overgrown garden seen from an elevated perspective. The horizon is blocked by dense foliage and tall trees that create a layered and deep visual effect. Fine brushstrokes and cross-hatching techniques are used to render the scene in a textured, monochrome style dominated by warm sepia tones and browns. The garden features a pathway, stone pillars with climbing vines, distant figures on a terrace, and a partially obscured statue, evoking a tranquil and secluded retreat within a cultivated landscape.

artworks.title: Park of an Italian Villa
artworks.medium: black chalk with brown wash heightened with white gouache on laid paper, with the remains of a framing line in brown ink
artworks.description: The image shows a garden scene with a man-made waterfall and a stone lion surrounded by trees. The horizon is obstructed by foliage, creating a sense of seclusion. Loose brushstrokes suggest textured leaves and soft light. The color palette is sepia with hints of charcoal and light washes. Two statues stand near a stone parapet with large pots. In the distance, an archway and garden walls are partly visible behind the dense trees.

artworks.title: The Fortress of San Andrea from the Lagoon
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash over black on laid paper, with some white gouache
artworks.description: The image depicts a view overlooking a body of water. Near the center of the image is a building with a flag on the horizon, surrounded by small trees and distant structures suggesting a shoreline. In the water are multiple small boats and gondolas with people rowing or managing them. The brushstrokes are delicate and fluid, using an ink wash technique for a soft atmosphere. The color palette is dominated by warm sepia tones, enhancing the peaceful ambiance. Boats are strategically placed in the composition, leading the viewer's gaze through the scene.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl
artworks.medium: black and red chalk
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing a head-and-shoulders view of an individual. The person is positioned facing slightly to their left, displaying a gentle turn of the head with a direct gaze towards the viewer. The person has delicate features, a slight smile, softly arched eyebrows, expressive eyes, curly and voluminous light-colored hair, and is wearing an off-the-shoulder top. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the person's hands. The background is simple and softly shaded, with no distinct objects or scenery, providing a neutral backdrop for the subject.

artworks.title: Farm Scene
artworks.medium: black chalk and pastel? on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape drawing of a rustic rural scene. Several figures are depicted, including a person walking a cow and two others seated on the ground. The scene includes a quaint, thatched-roof house surrounded by scattered farm paraphernalia. The style features impressionistic brushstrokes capturing the texture of the foliage and the roof. The color palette is soft, with muted earth tones and cool blues. Highlights are used to add depth to the architectural features and figures.

artworks.title: Two Seated Ladies
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rough sketch of two seated figures. Both figures are shown from head to feet. The person in the foreground is slightly turned to the side, leaning back with their legs extended forward and crossed at the ankles. Their facial features are indistinct, and the hair appears short and textured. This figure wears a flowing garment with folds around them and holds a folded fan. Behind and slightly to the left of this person, a second figure is seated with an arm raised toward their face. This figure's facial features and hair are also not clearly defined. The person appears to be wearing a similar flowing garment. The background is plain and unadorned.
